Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Longtime fans will immediately recognize Nils Hamm’s prolific portfolio of Magic art through the years. For Secret Lair, we’ve partnered with Nils to dream up card art inspired by classic stories. Remember books? In print, even? His gorgeous scenes pull from faves like The Odyssey and “The Rime of the Ancient Mariner” to perfectly complement the collection or deck of any literature lover. The colors! The details! The paired flavor text! If you’re on the same page, you’ll want to make like a library and check these out.

Contents:
• 1x Foil Deepglow Skate
• 1x Foil Tireless Tracker
• 1x Foil Contagion Engine
• 1x Foil Sword of Truth and Justice
